main.description: Klearsky client-specific record that stores a list of DIDs whose reposts should be muted.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this record was created (or last rewritten).

subjects.description: List of subjects (DIDs) whose reposts are muted in this client. Each entry includes when it was added.

subject.description: A DID added to repost-mute list and the timestamp when it was added.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this DID was added to the mute list.

did.description: DID of the user whose reposts are muted.
